roleDescriptions.owner: Manages the household, members and subscription.
roleDescriptions.caregiver: Can plan meals, edit family members and log food.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Can see plans and shopping lists but not change them.
roleDescriptions.coach: A health coach with read access to plans.

people.title: People with access
people.removeBody: {{name}} will lose access to this household's plans and family details.
people.leaveBody: You will lose access to its plans and family details until you are invited again.

invite.title: Invite to your household
invite.body: They'll get an email with a link. You can also share the link yourself, for example on WhatsApp.
invite.coachSoon: Coach access arrives in a later update.
invite.notYourself: You're already in this household. Enter someone else's email.
invite.alreadyMember: This person is already a member of the household.
invite.sentBody: We emailed {{email}}. The invitation is valid for {{days}} days.
invite.linkHelper: Only the invited email address can use this link.

accept.title: Join a household
accept.body: You've been invited to help plan meals for a family on Thuluth.
accept.joinedBody: You're now a {{role}} in this household.
accept.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this household.
accept.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the owner to send a new one.
accept.invalid: This invitation link is not valid or has been revoked.
accept.emailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with that address to accept it.
